catalogBehavior: Read-only S1MAPI PrefabRef.Find() scan; the mod never instantiates discovered prefabs during catalog export.
purpose: Registry of exact Schedule I prefabs and meshes verified in the current game build.
rules: Record exact asset names from runtime discovery; do not guess names.
Use native-prefabs.csv as the candidate survey, then verify every asset in the target game before adding it to entries.
A hasNetworkObject value of unknown means component inspection failed; do not assume the prefab is local-only.
Check for NetworkObject before choosing an instantiation path.
Use server-side network spawning for interactive networked prefabs.
Use InteriorBuilder or mesh references for static decoration.
